data.narrative:
Dominion Dynamics is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Eliot Pence (former Anduril International leadership, 2018–2022) and Mitch Carkner (ex-CEO Decisive, Amazon/IBM veteran, Canadian Forces background). The company has raised $18M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across public and private markets: 2 public entities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, spanning Seed through Series A stages.

Two valuation methods apply to Dominion. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $18M raised proxy, yielding $45M. Peer-median benchmarking across five same-sector comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Castelion ($1.0B Series A), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—produces a $1.0B median, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $38M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $522M. The substantial spread reflects the sector's wide heterogeneity in maturity and market positioning. Key uncertainties include differentiation relative to well-capitalized competitors, customer traction, and technology defensibility—factors not fully captured in stage-based or peer-median approaches alone.
